chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Yusuf ibn al-Harith, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Azrami, from his father Abd al-Rahman, from Abi Abd Allah, from his father, from his forefathers عليهم السلام, who said:

Umar was brought a man who had been penetrated in his anus, and he intended to flog him. So he said to the witnesses: “Did you see him insert it as the probe-stick enters the kohl container?” They said: “Yes.” Then he said to Ali عليه السلام: “What do you think about this?” So he sought the male who had penetrated him, but did not find him. Then Ali عليه السلام said: “My view concerning him is that you strike his neck.” He said: So he ordered it, and his neck was struck. He said: “Take him.” Then he said: “There still remains for him another punishment.” He said: “And what is it?” He said: “Call for a load of firewood.” So he called for a load of firewood, and he was wrapped in it, then he brought him out and burned him with fire.

He said: Then he said: “Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has servants who have in their loins wombs like the wombs of women.” He said: “Then why do they not carry in them?” He said: “Because it is inverted, and they have in their rears a gland like the gland of a camel; when it is aroused, they become aroused, and when it becomes still, they become still.”

key_terms.الشُّهُودِ: the witnesses whose testimony is requested
key_terms.الْمُكْحُلَةِ: the kohl container, used in a legal simile for clear penetration
key_terms.الْمِيلُ: the probe-stick used as a comparison for penetration
key_terms.حَطَبٍ: firewood; used in carrying out the punishment
key_terms.دُبُرِهِ: his anus; the location mentioned in the report
key_terms.عُقُوبَةٌ: punishment; an additional penalty mentioned in the report
key_terms.عُنُقَهُ: his neck; referring to execution by striking the neck
key_terms.غُدَّةٌ: a gland; mentioned in the descriptive statement at the end

ai.seo_question: What punishment is mentioned in this hadith for liwat in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal case involving liwat and presents Imam Ali’s عليه السلام judgment concerning the punishment. It also includes a statement describing a physical explanation related to the persons mentioned in the report, within the context of the ruling.
